summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending September 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, along with their respective growth percentages. Notably, revenues increased by 8.1%, while gross profit saw an 8.5% rise. Operating expenses grew by 11.3%, leading to an operating profit increase of 7.2%. The net profit before non-controlling interests rose by 10.9%, reflecting a positive trend in financial performance across the board.
